field_contract.evidence_date: Use an ISO 8601 calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format for evidence.date. Future-dated mannequin interface evidence is invalid because it cannot be completed evidence.
field_contract.placeholder_values: Placeholder text such as PENDING is treated as missing evidence case-insensitively and after trimming. Lowercase, padded, or whitespace-only placeholders cannot satisfy required FR-017 mannequin interface fields.
field_contract.test_subject: Mannequin interface evidence.mannequin_or_arm_form_id must identify a non-human mannequin or arm-form test subject. Any text that identifies a pilot, human, or wearer is invalid because this gate is not a pilot test.
field_contract.record_linkage: evidence.mockup_readiness_record_path must resolve to the same mockup record path passed into the mannequin interface gate. Do not point a mannequin record at stale, copied, or unrelated mockup evidence.
field_contract.evidence_chronology: Mannequin interface evidence.date must be the same as or later than the linked mockup evidence.date. Do not fabricate or backdate mannequin interface evidence before mockup evidence exists.
field_contract.required_pass_checks: Use unquoted JSON boolean true only when the mannequin/interface condition is directly verified. Use false for a verified failure; false blocks progression.
field_contract.fail_observations: Use false only when the fail condition is not observed. Use true when observed; true blocks progression. Do not use yes/no/1/0 or quoted true/false strings.
